title: Gain-Scheduled PID Autotuner
text: 在多个工作点自动整定 PID 增益，输入 9 路、输出 5 路；按 {Signal Amplitudes} 指定扰动幅值；{Controller type} 指定 PID 控制器作用、{Form} 指定 PID 控制器形式、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定 PID 控制器的采样时间、{Data Type} 指定浮点精度 double、{Tune at different sample time} 启用与 PID 控制器和实验不同的采样时间进行整定、{Tuning sample time (sec)} 指定整定算法的采样时间、{Integrator method} 指定积分项的离散积分公式 Forward、{Filter method} 指定微分滤波项的离散积分公式 Forward、{Target bandwidth (rad/sec)} 指定整定后响应的目标穿越频率、{Target phase margin (degrees)} 指定开环响应的目标最小相位裕度、{Experiment Mode} 指定扰动信号类型、{Plant Type} 指定被控对象稳定性、{Plant Sign} 指定被控对象符号、{Breakpoints} 指定 Gain scheduling breakpoints、{Use external signal} 指定 breakpoints from input port、{Number of breakpoints} 指定断点数、{Gain index tolerance}、{Use y as scheduling variable} 指定 Schedule breakpoints using plant output、{Method of storing gains}、{P Gain initial conditions} 指定 Proportional gain initial value、{P Gain Parameter Name} 指定比例增益数据名称、{I Gain initial conditions} 指定积分增益初始值、{I Gain Parameter Name} 指定积分增益数据名称、{D Gain initial conditions} 指定微分增益初始值、{D Gain Parameter Name} 指定微分增益数据名称、{N Gain initial conditions} 指定滤波器增益初始值、{N Gain Parameter Name} 指定滤波器增益数据名称、{Save breakpoints in gain array} 指定将断点与 PID 增益一起保存、{Method to trigger gain update} 指定更新触发方法 Detect change in PID、{Number of samples to delay update} 指定延迟更新的采样点数、{P gain lookup method} 指定比例增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End、{I gain lookup method} 指定积分增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End、{D gain lookup method} 指定微分增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End、{N gain lookup method} 指定微分滤波器增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End、{Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} 用于防止定点工具覆盖输出数据类型、{Integer rounding mode} 指定定点运算的舍入模式、{Output Signal Configuration} 指定提供控制信号加扰动或仅提供扰动 control action +、{Display Bode plot} 绘制估计频率响应、{Baseline plant model} 指定 Bode 图基线模型、{Display gain surface plot} 显示增益曲面图，按实例取值。

params.name: Controller type
params.values: PID 控制器作用 PIDN (default) | P | I | PI | PD | PDN | PID |...

params.name: Form
params.values: PID 控制器形式 Parallel (default) | Ideal

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: PID 控制器的采样时间 0.1 (default) | positive scalar | –1

params.name: Data Type
params.values: 浮点精度 double (default) | single

params.name: Tune at different sample time
params.values: 启用与 PID 控制器和实验不同的采样时间进行整定 off (default) | on

params.name: Tuning sample time (sec)
params.values: 整定算法的采样时间 0.2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: 积分项的离散积分公式 Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Filter method
params.values: 微分滤波项的离散积分公式 Forward Euler (default) | Backward Euler | Trapezoidal

params.name: Target bandwidth (rad/sec)
params.values: 整定后响应的目标穿越频率 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Target phase margin (degrees)
params.values: 开环响应的目标最小相位裕度 60 (default) | scalar in range 0–90

params.name: Experiment Mode
params.values: 扰动信号类型 Superposition (default) | Sinestream | PRBS

params.name: Plant Type
params.values: 被控对象稳定性 Stable (default) | Integrating

params.name: Plant Sign
params.values: 被控对象符号 Positive (default) | Negative

params.name: Signal Amplitudes
params.values: 扰动幅值 1 (default) | scalar | vector of length 5

params.name: Breakpoints
params.values: Gain scheduling breakpoints [1 2 3] (default) | vector

params.name: Use external signal
params.values: Specify breakpoints from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Number of breakpoints
params.values: 断点数 3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Gain index tolerance
params.values: Gain index tolerance 1e-3 (default) | nonegative scalar

params.name: Use y as scheduling variable
params.values: Schedule breakpoints using plant output on (default) | off

params.name: Method of storing gains
params.values: Method of storing gains Internal to block (default) | Data store memory

params.name: P Gain initial conditions
params.values: Proportional gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: P Gain Parameter Name
params.values: 比例增益数据名称 PGain (default) | string

params.name: I Gain initial conditions
params.values: 积分增益初始值 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: I Gain Parameter Name
params.values: 积分增益数据名称 IGain (default) | string

params.name: D Gain initial conditions
params.values: 微分增益初始值 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: D Gain Parameter Name
params.values: 微分增益数据名称 DGain (default) | string

params.name: N Gain initial conditions
params.values: 滤波器增益初始值 100 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: N Gain Parameter Name
params.values: 滤波器增益数据名称 NGain (default) | string

params.name: Save breakpoints in gain array
params.values: 将断点与 PID 增益一起保存 off (default) | on

params.name: Method to trigger gain update
params.values: 更新触发方法 Detect change in PID gains (default) | External trigger

params.name: Number of samples to delay update
params.values: 延迟更新的采样点数 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: P gain lookup method
params.values: 比例增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.name: I gain lookup method
params.values: 积分增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.name: D gain lookup method
params.values: 微分增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.values: 微分滤波器增益查找方法 Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 用于防止定点工具覆盖输出数据类型的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: 定点运算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Output Signal Configuration
params.values: 提供控制信号加扰动或仅提供扰动 control action + perturbation (default) | perturbation only

params.values: Bode 图基线模型 [] (default) | LTI model

params.values: 显示增益曲面图 off (default) | on
